title: AXe agent result, adaptive schema version 2
description: The compact --agent result returned by the default reading view and by --view navigation. It is a projection of base schema version 1 over the same snapshot and references that keeps only what an agent acts on: constants, request echoes, internal correlation, timings and device identities stay in the full view. Fields can be added within a schema version, so consumers should ignore properties they do not know. Strings such as outcome and cache status are open sets; branch on didError, error.code and data.cache. nextSteps entries are guidance for a language model, not a stable contract.

screen.description: The selected display when the reply has no capture.

cache.description: Present only when the snapshot is stale: capture or read again before a reference action.

nextSteps.description: Plain-language recovery and continuation guidance, absent when there is none. The wording can change in any release.

code.description: Typed failure code to branch on, for example screenChanged, targetChanged, targetCovered, busy or quarantined. The agent reference lists the refusal codes.

message.description: At most 1024 Unicode scalars. A longer message keeps its prefix and suffix around an omission separator.

status.description: For example invalidated, busy, quarantined or unobserved.

screen.description: [screenID, logicalWidth, logicalHeight, rotationDegrees] of the selected display.

row.description: One compact row: ref|actions|role|label|value. Actions are comma-separated. A literal pipe inside a cell is shown as a slash; a cell longer than 160 Unicode scalars is clipped and listed in truncatedFields.

unchangedCapture.description: Reply to --since-screen-hash when the screen still matches. Keep the screen hash from the matching capture.

expiresInSeconds.description: Rounded down. Validation, paging and reads do not renew it.

keyboard.description: Present when keyboard evidence shows a likely visible keyboard. Absence does not prove the keyboard is hidden.

page.description: Absent when no page metadata is needed. Pass nextOffset as --row-offset to continue the same snapshot.

unavailableReferences.description: Refs on this page that cannot take input, mapped to nativeIdentityIncomplete.

customActionGroups.description: Read-only custom-action name previews, grouped by identical ordered names. Names are information, not input actions.

truncatedFields.description: Display cells clipped to 160 Unicode scalars. Read the exact field with --read-ref.

areas.description: Read-only preview of scroll areas from the same snapshot when the first page has no scroll rows.

quarantine.description: Present when input could not be released cleanly. All input on the simulator is blocked until the record is checked and deleted.

actionReceipt.description: Transport evidence for one action. It is not proof of the app's response. A single action omits kind; a batch step omits it when it equals the step action.

outcome.description: For example enqueuedAndDrained, rejectedBeforeInput or failedNoReplay.

cleanup.description: Absent when no cleanup was needed. For example released or uncertain; never repeat uncertain input.

retried.description: True when a refusal before input was recovered inside this call from a fresh read.

finalValue.description: The last native value read, in the slider's own domain.

batchStep.description: One step's status, input evidence and refusal. Request IDs, per-step cache and context stay in the full view.

batch.description: Ordered step receipts. Completed steps are never undone or replayed. A completed batch with a refreshed final capture omits totalSteps.

observation.description: Evidence from a failed accessibility read.

observedPID.description: The app that owned the screen when the read failed.

detail.description: One exact field chunk from describe-ui --read-ref. Offsets count Unicode scalars; pass nextOffset as --text-offset for the next chunk.
